steps.title: Hire a graphic designer for branding and signage
steps.why: A clear visual identity helps attract walk‑in customers and makes your shop recognizable. Professional logo and signage ensure consistency across physical and digital touchpoints.

steps.title: Hire a photographer for product and store images
steps.why: High‑quality photos showcase your offerings and can be used in ads, social posts, and online listings, which are essential for drawing interest.

steps.title: Hire a social media marketer to run targeted campaigns
steps.why: Strategic social‑media ads and regular posting reach local audiences, driving foot traffic and awareness. A specialist can set up targeting and manage budgets efficiently.

steps.title: Hire a content writer for engaging copy
steps.why: Compelling captions, promos, and blog snippets keep your audience interested and improve ad performance. Consistent, persuasive language reinforces your brand message.

steps.title: Hire a web developer to create a simple website or landing page
steps.why: An online presence lets potential customers find store details, hours, and promotions, supporting offline visits. A basic site also boosts credibility.
